ingredients.monosodium glutamate: flavour enhancer commonly used in processed foods
ingredients.citric acid: acidity regulator and preservative commonly found in fruits
ingredients.microcrystalline cellulose: stabilizer and texturizer derived from wood pulp
ingredients.soy lecithin: emulsifier that helps prevent ingredient separation
ingredients.ascorbic acid: antioxidant and preservative, also known as Vitamin C
ingredients.xanthan gum: thickening agent and stabilizer used for texture consistency
ingredients.guar gum: natural thickening agent obtained from guar beans
ingredients.carrageenan: thickener and stabilizer extracted from red seaweed
ingredients.calcium propionate: preservative commonly used to prevent mold in baked goods
ingredients.sodium benzoate: preservative used in acidic foods to prevent spoilage
ingredients.potassium sorbate: preservative used to prevent mold and yeast growth
ingredients.caramel color: coloring agent manufactured by heating carbohydrates
ingredients.titanium dioxide: white coloring pigment used to alter appearance
ingredients.powdered cellulose: anti-caking agent and texturizer used in powdered foods
ingredients.diphosphates: emulsifier and stabilizer used in processed food products
ingredients.sodium carbonates: acidity regulator and raising agent used in baking
ingredients.sucrose: standard sugar sweetener providing flavor and energy
ingredients.high fructose corn syrup: concentrated liquid sweetener made from corn starch
ingredients.stevia: natural non-caloric sweetener extracted from stevia leaves
ingredients.aspartame: artificial non-caloric sweetener used in low-calorie foods
ingredients.acesulfame potassium: artificial sweetener commonly blended with other sweeteners
ingredients.palm oil: saturated plant-based oil commonly used for texture
ingredients.canola oil: liquid vegetable oil low in saturated fats
ingredients.soybean oil: vegetable oil commonly used in food processing
ingredients.coconut oil: saturated plant-based oil used for cooking and texture

categories.SWEETENER: sweetening agent used to add flavor and sweetness to food products
categories.PRESERVATIVE: substance added to food products to prevent decay or spoilage and extend shelf life
categories.EMULSIFIER: additive that helps mix and stabilize ingredients that would otherwise separate
categories.STABILIZER: additive that maintains the physical texture, structure, and consistency of food products
categories.ACIDITY_REGULATOR: ingredient used to control or alter the acidity or alkalinity of food products
categories.FLAVOUR_ENHANCER: compound added to foods to enhance their existing savory or sweet flavors
categories.OIL: fat source commonly used for texture, moisture, or cooking in processed foods
categories.COLORING: food additive used to impart or restore color to food products
categories.ADDITIVE: general food additive used for technological purposes during processing
categories.UNKNOWN: ingredient with an unspecified category or primary function
